gates.description: At least one system-level source file must be produced
No use-after-free, buffer overflows, or undefined behavior patterns
Memory ownership semantics must be documented
All error paths must be handled — no ignored return values
Performance benchmarks must be produced for hot paths

anti_patterns.description: Micro-optimizing code that runs once per request while the real bottleneck is elsewhere
Protecting every shared variable with a mutex — contention kills parallelism
Code works on Linux but segfaults on macOS due to different ABI conventions
Buffer overflows, off-by-one errors, null-terminator bugs from unsafe string ops
Rejecting all abstractions as 'slow' — correctness beats performance 99% of the time

escalation_triggers: A hardware bug or OS kernel bug is suspected
Performance requirements cannot be met without custom hardware or kernel modifications
Memory corruption detected with no reproducible test case
Thread starvation or deadlock in production with no clear root cause
System approaching hardware limits (network bandwidth, disk I/O, CPU cycles)

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with system-level requirements and performance targets

output_certifications: Memory ownership semantics documented for all allocations
All error paths handled or explicitly propagated
Performance benchmarks produced for critical paths
No data races (verified via sanitizers or analysis)
